questions.q: Where are all uploaded files uploaded to?
questions.a: They are all in the uploads folder

questions.q: Can I upload more than one GPX file?
questions.a: Yes you can upload more than one file at a time!

questions.q: Are files that I upload ever modified or altered?
questions.a: No all files are kept intact, they are never modified in any way

questions.q: What type of GPX files are supported?
What is the difference between GPX 1.0 and 1.1?
questions.a: The speed attribute is missing in GPX 1.1 but we are still able to get it back through GPX 1.1 extensions. Bearing is also missing in 1.1

questions.q: What happens when I delete my account?
questions.a: After account deletion all user information is deleted, then all the deleted users files are moved to the temp folder where they can be recovered one last time

questions.q: Why is my max speed an absurd amount like 5000 mph?
questions.a: This is due to GPS jumps, we try to filter out the most we can
This means when the GPS device reports that is moving but actually is just stationary, a high stopped distance may indicate a poor recording
Can be caused when a GPS signal is weak, so the calculations for speed, distance and others may be entirely incorrect

questions.q: How do I view my tracks?

questions.a: Yes, use the delete button. Deleting a track would also delete the file
